ei.title: Chapter 1-04 3번: The Impact of Television on Sports
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Radio provided the driving force to solidify the era of patronage; however, the invention that soon followed remains to this day the most significant communication medium that has influenced and aided the development of sports. Who knew what sportscaster Bill Stern questioned and introduced in 1939 would enhance the growth and development of sports marketing practices for decades? The display platform, the television, though airing two average baseball teams battling for fourth place, provided an incredibly formidable and profitable union between sports and the American public. The television provided a means for sports organizations to expand their market presence and a unique opportunity for marketers to engage their publics. The notion of a "picture being worth a thousand words" became a reality with the invention and its intervention and presentation of sports.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 가장 중요한(significant) 의사소통 매체로, 스포츠 발전에 영향을 미치고(influenced) 도왔다(aided).

questions.passage: Radio provided the driving force to solidify the era of patronage; however, the invention that soon followed remains to this day the most significant communication medium that has influenced and aided the development of sports. Who knew what sportscaster Bill Stern questioned and introduced in 1939 would enhance the growth and development of sports marketing practices for decades? The display platform, the television, though airing two average baseball teams battling for fourth place, provided an incredibly formidable and profitable union between sports and the American public. The television provided a means for sports organizations to expand their market presence and __________. The notion of a "picture being worth a thousand words" became a reality with the invention and its intervention and presentation of sports.

det.korean: TV는 스포츠 조직이 시장 존재감을 확장할 수단과 '마케터들이 대중의 관심을 끌 독특한 기회'를 제공했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① a unique opportunity for marketers to engage their publics — 마케터가 대중 관심을 끌 독특한 기회 ←정답
❌ ② an incredibly formidable union between sports — 스포츠 간 어마어마한 결합 (앞 문장 개념, 수단과 병렬 아님)
❌ ③ the driving force to solidify the era — 시대를 굳히는 원동력 (첫 문장 개념, TV가 아닌 라디오)
❌ ④ the growth and development of sports marketing — 스포츠 마케팅의 성장과 발전 (2번째 문장 개념, 여기서는 TV가 제공한 것)
